text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime minister highlights importance of oil production.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Co to sign U.S. software contract.
- Bahrain's economy on road to recovery.
- Anti-pollution efforts are duty of oil industry.
- New oil and gas projects to be launched in Bahrain including a gas pipeline at a cost of 26 million dinars.
- Bahrain's State Security Court adjourns verdicts of coup suspects.
